title: Upper semicontinuity of the density under a monotonicity bound with vanishing error
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U a subset of R^(n+l), V a rectifiable n-varifold in U with weight mu, y in R^(n+l), t1 > 0 and Lambda : R -> R with Lambda(t) -> 0 as t -> 0+; mu(B_r(z)) means (V.weight (closedBall z r)).toReal and omega_n := unitBallVolume n. Assume (hmon): for every t in (0, t1] and every z in B_t(y) there is a real Theta >= 0 with V.HasDensity z Theta and omega_n Theta <= exp(Lambda(t)) r^(-n) mu(B_r(z)) + Lambda(t) for all r in (0, t). Let Theta_y >= 0 with V.HasDensity y Theta_y, and let c > Theta_y. Then there is d > 0 such that every z in B_d(y) has some real Theta < c with V.HasDensity z Theta.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (y : Amb n ℓ) (t₁ : ℝ) (Λ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < t₁ → Tendsto Λ (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → (∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 t₁, ∀ z ∈ closedBall y t, ∃ Θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Θ ∧ V.HasDensity z Θ ∧ ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 t, unitBallVolume n * Θ ≤ Real.exp (Λ t) * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall z r)).toReal + Λ t) → ∀ Θy : ℝ, 0 ≤ Θy → V.HasDensity y Θy → ∀ c : ℝ, Θy < c → ∃ d > 0, ∀ z ∈ closedBall y d, ∃ Θ : ℝ, Θ < c ∧ V.HasDensity z Θ
